note: Gathering on foot (docs/future/13-keepers-camp.md 4.2, 4.4, 4.5; src/world/gather/). reachM: arm's reach (m) for a Gather; waterReachM: into water from the bank (lily leaves, pondweed). nearLookM: ground that is everywhere (sand, pebbles, flat stones, a strandline stretch) opens its card when tapped within this many meters of the walker; a tap further off just walks (Matt, 2026-10-22). kneelS: the kneel for one handful; approachTimeoutS: how long the walk to a spot may take before it gives up. eventCap: the most picked spots the save remembers (oldest go first). spotM: the side of a ground spot's bin (m), over the 0.5 m water cells. marksMax: picked-over marks drawn near the view. plants: regrowth model B. A pick sets size = max(floor x best, size x (1 - share)); a plant is pickable when it has been mature (best at least matureSize), its size is at least readyShare x best, and the part is in its season window. While size < readyShare x best, a picked plant's hourly growth is multiplied by recoverRate x (1 + rainBoost x rain + mistBoost x mist), rain and mist this hour's (weather now). defaults: share and readyShare by part type. parts: one entry per gatherable plant part, keyed '<species>.<part>', naming its type (for the defaults) and its window as season positions [from, to) (0 spring .. 4, wrapping, as flora recipes' flowering and dormant windows), read on the world's calendar (the season the island shows); its own share or readyShare overrides the type's; a part picked twice a year lists both windows, [[from, to), [from, to)]. Reed down: late autumn into winter. weather: windyMin is the day record's windStrength for a windy day (today or yesterday); onshoreDot: a tide's day is onshore when dot(windToward, outward) is at most this, windToward = (cos windDir, -sin windDir), outward from the island's centre to the stretch; springMin: how far toward spring a line's tide must be for cast kelp; fireNightH: hours a fire must burn between dusk and dawn. bins: steepDeg is the slope (degrees) at which sand on the shore counts as shingle; ankleM is the deepest a stream bed's water may be for pebbles; tapM, how near its cell (m) a tap must land to find a bin's spot. strand: toleranceM, how far (m) a cell's ground may sit from a line's level (plus the shore recipe's runupM) and still be on it. kinds: one per ground kind (Phase 1: sticks, drift twigs, pebbles, flat stones). source is where it lies (foot of a host plant, a ground bin, a strandline stretch); handfuls and empty are by season (spring, summer, autumn, winter): empty is the share of spots holding nothing that period, otherwise a spot holds handfuls plus the modifiers. sticks: hosts and hostMin (the least stage of the host); windy adds that many on a windy day (today or yesterday), when empty is emptyWindy instead. drift-twigs: lines is how many of the newest lines carry them; onshore adds that many when the tide's day was onshore, when empty is emptyOnshore. pebbles and flat stones: where names the ground they lie on (shoreShingle: sand or shingle in or above the tide band; streamBed: running or slow fresh water no deeper than ankleM; bandRock: rock in the tide band; steepShingle: shore sand at least steepDeg steep). cluster (F6, Matt, October 23, 2026: about a fifth as many as before): a beach kind lies in a few natural clusters, its bins grouped in cells of cellBins a side and a cell kept with chance keep (a strandline's clusters move with each tide); nearBoat: within radiusM of where the boat lands the keeper every bin is in play, with these empty shares, so the first evening always has drift twigs and stones close by. words: the card's lines. Out of season (plants.js outOfSeasonLine), a dormant plant says resting; any other says nothingNow and when the part comes: comes[part] (or comes.default) with {when} said against the season the island shows: soon within soonDays game days, later this {season} if it opens further on in this same season, else the third of the season its window opens in (when, twelve thirds from early spring). Part windows are read on the world's calendar, the one the island shows. lookOnly (docs/future/13 PR-44): plants never gathered; their card says notForDrinking with Leave it be, and the first time the walker meets one, refused[plant] shows for refusedS seconds and its page learns why. The four tea herbs (P2b, docs/future/13 5.4): water mint leaves mid spring to autumn, meadowsweet flowers in high summer, nettle tops in spring and again in autumn, chamomile flowers summer into early autumn. Winter picks (docs/future/13 5.2): gorse flowers all year, willow withies and bark all winter; reed down from autumn, when the seed heads turn brown, into winter.

words.strandPicked: Picked over. The next tide will bring more.
words.young: Still small. Let it grow first.
words.holding: It is holding on to the rock. Leave it be.
words.above: You can gather this on foot.
words.sleepers: Frogs sleep in the mud here.
words.tooBig: Too big to lift. It is rooted deep.

refused.iris: Not this one. Iris root is poison, so I only look.
refused.marigold: Not this one. Its sap blisters the hands, so I only look.

words.acorns: Too bitter. These are for the jay.
